commandTests.name: Emulator health endpoint
args:
asrs-emulator start -i 127.0.0.1 >/tmp/emulator-smoke.log 2>&1 & pid=$!; trap 'kill $pid 2>/dev/null || true; wait $pid 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT; for attempt in {1..30}; do kill -0 $pid || { cat /tmp/emulator-smoke.log; exit 1; }; if timeout 2 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8888; printf "HEAD /api/health HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost
Connection: close

" >&3; IFS= read -r status <&3; [[ $status == HTTP/1.?\ 200* ]]' 2>/dev/null; then echo 'PASS emulator container health'; exit 0; fi; sleep 1; done; cat /tmp/emulator-smoke.log; exit 1
